trigger_keywords: sofa in a box New York

nyc_logistics_audit.shipping_fee_structure: STRING (Identify hidden fees or flat rates)
nyc_logistics_audit.box_dimensions_stated: BOOLEAN (Does the brand explicitly guarantee fitting narrow hallways/walk-ups?)

financial_and_pricing_audit.entry_sofa_price_usd: NUMBER (Track their hero product base price)
financial_and_pricing_audit.return_policy_friction_level: STRING (Check for return shipping fees or restocking fees)

supply_chain_and_compliance_audit.country_of_origin: ARRAY (Where are their products manufactured? e.g., Vietnam, Malaysia, China, USA)
supply_chain_and_compliance_audit.anti_dumping_risk_level: ENUM [Low, Medium, High] (Evaluate based on category and country of origin)
supply_chain_and_compliance_audit.material_compliance: ARRAY (e.g., CertiPUR-US, FSC Certified Wood, OEKO-TEX)

marketing_intel.nyc_localization_tactics: ARRAY (e.g., Subway ads, local showrooms, geo-targeted popups)

analysis_and_scoring_skills.calculate_nyc_fit_score: Formula: (0.35 * Modularity/Packaging) + (0.25 * Logistics/COI Capability) + (0.20 * Supply Chain Margin Resilience) + (0.20 * Pricing/Aesthetics)

swot_generation_template.core_advantage: What makes them winning in tight NYC apartments?
swot_generation_template.fatal_weakness: Where are NYC customers leaving 1-star reviews? (e.g., package theft, stairs refusal)
swot_generation_template.supply_chain_risk: Are they highly vulnerable to tariff increases or anti-dumping investigations?
